name: Himouto! Umaru-chan ~Himouto! Ikusei Keikaku~
original_name: 干物妹！うまるちゃん ～干物妹！育成計画～
source:
Adaptation based on a manga by Sankaku Head, the series follows Doma Umaru, a high school girl who lives with her older brother Taihei. At school, Umaru appears to be the ideal student with good looks, top grades, and a lot of talent. Once she gets home, however, she reverts into a layabout who spends her time lying around, playing video games, and constantly depending on her older brother, much to Taihei's dismay. 

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Himouto!_Umaru-chan]Wikipedia[/url]]

In the game, all of Umaru’s belongings have been taken away from her by Taihei so she can be more productive, but all these means is that the player will have to take care of her, and help her with her habits.

When Umaru isn’t at home being lazy, the game will switch to a visual novel format.

[From [url=http://thevitalounge.net/2015/07/06/game-based-on-anime-himouto-umaru-chan-to-hit-vita/]The Vita Lounge[/url]]

The game will also have original story that haven't been told in the both manga and anime.
translation:
本作改编自三角头创作的漫画，讲述了与哥哥太平同住的高中女生土间埋。学校里的埋外表漂亮、成绩优秀、才华横溢，是理想学生。然而回到家，她就会变成一个无所事事的宅女，整天躺着、打游戏，还总是依赖哥哥，让太平十分头疼。

[摘自[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Himouto!_Umaru-chan]维基百科[/url]]

在游戏中，太平没收了埋的所有物品，希望她能够变得更有效率。但这样一来，玩家就必须照顾她，帮助她改掉懒散的习惯。

埋不在家里偷懒时，游戏会切换成视觉小说形式。

[摘自[url=http://thevitalounge.net/2015/07/06/game-based-on-anime-himouto-umaru-chan-to-hit-vita/]The Vita Lounge[/url]]

游戏还会讲述漫画和动画中没有出现过的原创故事。
